rationale: Hourly BTCUSDT momentum was tested because MACD crossovers are a plausible momentum family, recent swing structure confirmation may filter false signals, and the 1h timeframe offered an active intraday layer with more observations than daily bars while avoiding the highest-turnover 15m/30m layers. RETROSPECTIVE: this plan was authored after execution as part of WP-6b to exercise the schema grammar. The original H-005 pre-registration lives in research/hypotheses/H-005/HYPOTHESIS.md and was not schema-validated at the time.
hypothesis_to_test: An hourly MACD crossover strategy with price-structure confirmation on BTCUSDT perpetuals will generate OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs, capture directional momentum only when price confirms through recent structure, reduce false crossover exposure versus a MACD-only baseline, and survive walk-forward validation with efficiency > 0.5.

additional_criteria: OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs
Gate 2 passes under current evaluator semantics: dsr_val > 0.95 versus the expected maximum-SR benchmark from the registered trial count
Max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold
Parameter sensitivity: +/-25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline
No single 90-day window contributes > 60% of total PnL
Kill criteria from H-005 HYPOTHESIS.md apply: OOS Sharpe < 0.3, max drawdown > 35%, cost drag > 50% of gross PnL, structure confirmation failure, or both long and short legs unprofitable

data_requirements: No separate IS/OOS split convention existed in repo truth for this baseline; DEC-0005 records full-period Sharpe in both trial-log Sharpe fields
author: WP-6b retrospective
